title: Farmland World
description: The world generator adds endless farmlands
body:
## **❤️ Farmland World – The world generator adds endless farmlands**

### Overview
This mod adds a new world type generator called “Farmland World”, which creates endless farmlands. </br>
The mod is experimental and will serve as the foundation for my future project.


---

### Key Features

- **New World Type**  
  

![New World Type](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f532a2eb16030ba98fd000dd6954185806bbf7b9_0.webp)

![endless farmlands](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bece05bc71b1e30cbdd2cda1a332bc9020951fe2.jpeg)

![Sky view](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4d2c323e55fdde008094578910c6f790a60f652.jpeg)

---

### Recommended

The mod looks best when used together with the [Fancy Crops Resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/fancy-crops)
and [Distant Horizons](https://modrinth.com/mod/distanthorizons). </br>
Shaderpack [Photon Shaders](https://modrinth.com/shader/photon-shader)

---

### See Also

My main mod [Heart Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/heart-mod) </br>
Start with 5 hearts and collect Heart Crystals to increase your maximum health
